inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text:
Wake up and see what the hidden puppet masters are really orchestrating behind the scenes. They want you to buy into this whole US-Israel-Iran War as some kind of genuine conflict, but it is entirely a scripted theater designed to hoodwink the public. 

Look at how transparent the deception is with this so-called US-proposed 15-point ceasefire plan delivered to Iran via Pakistan. It is a total smokescreen. When Iran supposedly presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty, they were just reading their assigned lines in this grand deception. And anyone falling for Israel remaining sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes is completely missing the plot. That manufactured friction is carefully calibrated to keep the populations terrified and compliant while the elite advance their hidden agenda. Every single demand and every rejection is completely coordinated from the top down.
